title: DNP3 (Distributed Network Protocol), serial data link layer
description: SCADA/utility protocol. Its data-link CRC is exactly this schema's existing crc-16-dnp preset -- unused since it was first added several rounds ago. Its real structural novelty: data is chunked into 16-byte blocks, EACH with its own trailing CRC, not one check for the whole frame.

commands.name: DataLinkFrame
commands.description: control/destination/source are the LENGTH-counted header; userData is the application payload. userData is actually split into 16-byte blocks, each followed by its OWN separate CRC-16/DNP (the final block may be shorter) -- now recorded via framing.dataBlockChecking, though variableLength:remainder here still computes userData's byte count by simple subtraction against the frame's declared length, which INCLUDES the interleaved per-block check bytes; the true logical (non-check) data length is smaller and only recoverable by actually walking the blocks, not by this schema's arithmetic alone -- see dataBlockChecking's own description.
